items.title: Submit last three months' bank statements
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date: 05.11.2025. No period to count, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed since Wed 5 Nov 2025 is a regular business day.

items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the Änderungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 15.10.2025; under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a posted social-law letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sun 19.10.2025 (this day does not shift for social-law deemed delivery). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day; under § 188 Abs. 1 BGB it ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Wed 19.11.2025. That day is Buß- und Bettag, a public holiday in Sachsen, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next business day, Thu 20.11.2025.

warnings: The letter warns that benefits from December cannot be approved without the requested bank statements — make sure to send them by 05.11.2025 to avoid an interruption in payments.
